Input list

What we cover

Every event has a different room, crowd and run sheet. These are the jobs we do most.

  1. CH 01 Weddings

    Clear sound for the ceremony and speeches, music for the reception, and lighting that turns the venue into the room you pictured.

  2. CH 02 Corporate events

    Conferences, launches, awards nights and presentations. Wireless mics, playback and stage lighting that keep the day running to time.

  3. CH 03 Festivals

    PA and lighting for outdoor and multi-act stages, mixed by people who know what a band needs to hear.

  4. CH 04 Anything else

    School concerts, theatre, community events, private parties. If it needs sound or lighting, ask us.

Hire and operation

What we supply

Sound

  • PA systems sized to the room or outdoor stage
  • Wireless handheld and lapel mics for speeches
  • Mixing for bands, DJs and presentations
  • Playback and background music
  • Stage monitoring for bands and performers

Lighting

  • Uplighting to colour a room to your theme
  • Dance floor and party lighting
  • Stage and band lighting
  • Spot and feature lighting for speeches and stages
  • Lighting design and operation for larger stages

We set up, soundcheck, operate and pack down, so you can focus on the event.

From enquiry to pack-down

How it works

  1. Tell us about it

    Send the date, venue, rough guest numbers and what is happening on the day.

  2. Get a plan and a quote

    We recommend sound and lighting to suit the room and the run sheet, with a price you can check.

  3. We run it

    Our crew arrives early, sets up, soundchecks, operates through the event and packs down after.

About us

Run by people who play and mix live

Overdrive Music Studio is run by working musicians and live sound techs. We know what a band needs on stage, what an MC needs in the room, and what a wedding needs to feel right.

That means fewer surprises on the day, and someone on your crew who can fix a problem before your guests hear it.
